description: Defines the upper PHY implementation class and its configuration, including related classes, methods, and external dependencies for the ocudu namespace. It manages upper PHY components such as processing pools, validators, notifiers, and timing handlers.

classes.description: Internal class implementing the upper_phy_timing_handler interface, handling timing events and propagating them via a notifier.
